sentences.text:
----------------------------------------------------------------------
Hon'ble Vivek Bharti Sharma, J.
This criminal misc. application is filed under Section 528 of B.N.S.S. by the petitioner/accused for quashing of the charge-sheet dated 30.11.2022, summoning order dated 04.03.2023, as well as the entire proceedings of Criminal Case No.1695 of 2023 titled as "State vs. Anshul Mamgain" pending in the court of learned Chief Judicial Magistrate, Dehradun under Sections 323, 498A & 504 of IPC,
P.S. Dalanwala, District Dehradun qua the petitioner/accused, in view of the compromise arrived at between the parties.

2. In view of the fact that a Compounding 2025:UHC:4470 Application (IA No. 01 of 2025) was filed by the parties before this Court, this Court vide order dated 07.05.2025 had directed the parties to appear before the Secretary, District Legal Services Authority, District Dehradun in order to get their statements recorded and to verify the compromise deed.

entities.text: District Legal Services Authority, District Dehradun
entities.label: ORG

sentences.text: 3. Pursuant to such order, the Secretary, District Legal Services Authority, District Dehradun has submitted the report dated 15.05.2025 which clearly indicates that the parties have settled the dispute amicably and have also verified the contents of the compromise.

sentences.text: In view of the above, Compounding Application (IA No.1 of 2025) is allowed.

As a consequence thereof, the charge-sheet dated 30.11.2022, summoning order dated 04.03.2023, as well as the entire proceedings of Criminal Case No.1695 of 2023 titled as "State vs. Anshul Mamgain"
pending in the court of learned Chief Judicial Magistrate, Dehradun under Sections 323, 498A & 504 of IPC, P.S. Dalanwala, District Dehradun are hereby quashed qua the petitioner.
Present petition u/s 528 of B.N.S.S. is, thus, disposed of in terms of the compromise arrived at between the parties.
